final:
job_x() -> str =
  ex job_x() == "x"
  "x"

wrapped(job: () -> str) -> str =
  post out.char_count() >= 10
  ex wrapped(job_x) == "start:x:end"
  "start:" + job() + ":end"

test_wrapped() =
  assert wrapped(job_x) == "start:x:end"
